head.i: Differtne Regula Societatis à Regula Detri?

main_text.p: Regula societatis parùm aut nihil differt à Regula Detri, teste Gemma Frisio.

Quatuor mercatores inito confortio lucrati sunt 3000 aureorum, sed primus contulit tantùm 30 aureos, secundus 50, tertius 60, quartus 100, in quæstionem vocatur, quantum cedere debeat unicuiq; ex lucro pro pecunia forti commissa? Colligo omnium pecuniâ collatam in unam summam, per additionem sic:
Nũc dico 240 aurei lucrati sunt 3000 aureorum, quantum 30, lucrantur?

page.notes: The calculation at the top has symbols between the figures that I cannot read; they are marked as illegible. The rules under the calculation are printed and are not transcribed as text. The figures in the example are printed with old-style zeros; they are given here as ordinary digits. The reading "Differtne" in the title is doubtful. The left margin of the page is empty.
